conviction_note: Two small offsetting new-information findings (a documented 30-day bar on new company financings and insider sales after the 2026-09-29 closing, against roughly 4.5M underwater direct-offering shares with no investor lock-up) sum to +0.25, while the scaled number leans slightly negative (p_up 48 on abs 9) because the 42.8% ATR, the -46% five-day slide and this name's recent run of continued falls weigh against a bounce; the gap is small and both are close to a non-result; no repricing mechanism was found.
bar: Sized against the name's own recent drop history in the baseline (12 events since 2026-09-08, next-close moves -17.5% to +230%, median abs ~8%), ATR14 42.8%, and the 2026-09-28 SPA terms in https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1907223/000121390026104114/ea0306753-424b5_green.htm; no option chain (no_options_market).

cause.what_happened: At 08:45 ET on 2026-10-05 GRML announced it had exercised its option to take its AnorTech stake to 19.9%, paid in locked-up GRML shares (~US$5.3M at a 10-day VWAP); the stock gapped up +9.6% at the open and faded -13.3% intraday on ordinary (1.01x) volume to -4.95% by 15:04 ET, continuing a five-day slide of -46% from the $12/$13 direct-offering prices of 2026-09-23 and 2026-09-28.

positioning_check: Nasdaq short interest at settlement 2026-09-15: 508,658 shares, days to cover 1.0, down 21% from 643,675 on 2026-08-31 (https://api.nasdaq.com/api/quote/GRML/short-interest?assetclass=stocks). Both settlements predate the 2026-09-18 +230% spike and the two direct offerings, and FINRA publishes about eight business days after settlement, so the position carried into today is not observable. With ~13.3M shares outstanding the last read was under 4% of shares. There is no option chain, so no skew. Insider record: one open-market buy in 3 months per Nasdaq; a director's Form 144 for 3,500 shares (~$32k) dated 2026-10-01, which is trivial.

findings.finding: The 2026-09-28 securities purchase agreement bars the company from any financing for 30 days after the ~2026-09-29 closing (subject to certain exceptions) and from variable-rate deals for six months, and puts directors and officers under a 30-day lock-up, so neither an offering nor an ATM draw nor an insider sale can land tonight or tomorrow.
findings.mechanism_in_window: The usual second shoe for a serial issuer, an overnight offering, is contractually shut through about 2026-10-29, so the window carries no new company supply. The ATM with A.G.P. was also terminated on 2026-09-23.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This issuer has done five registered offerings or takedowns since 2026-08-24 (424B5s on 08-24, 08-25, 08-27, 09-23, 09-28); the 2026-09-28 raise came on a -19.2% day followed by -12.45%. A financing-free window has not occurred since August.
findings.why_not_priced: A price that held this would not carry the serial-diluter discount on the next session. Given five raises in five weeks, the tape's default reading of GRML is that it is about to sell more stock; the prospectus-supplement covenant that says it cannot is inside a 424B5, not in any headline.
findings.independence: The 8-K of the same date records that the A.G.P. ATM was terminated on 2026-09-23 after $1,388,827 sold: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1907223/000121390026104099/ea0306751-8k_greenland.htm

findings.finding: Institutional buyers of 4.52M shares and share-equivalents in the 2026-09-23 ($12.00) and 2026-09-28 ($13.00) registered directs are 38-42% underwater at $7.49, and neither 8-K nor the 424B5 places any lock-up on those investors, so they can keep selling in the window.
findings.mechanism_in_window: The shares are registered and freely tradable now, and the 1,434,580 pre-funded warrants convert at $0.0001, so this supply is available any session including 2026-10-06. That is an inference about holder behaviour, not a dated event.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: After the 09-23 raise the stock ran +33% the next session and then fell from the offering prices on 09-28 (-19.2%), 09-29 (-12.45%), 10-01 (-14.2%) and 10-02 (-13.5%) per the baseline's own-falls table, consistent with offering holders exiting.
findings.why_not_priced: Part of it is surely priced, since the stock already fell 46% in five sessions. What is not priced is that this is a seller with no lock-up and a reason to sell into any bounce, which caps the upside of a gap-and-fade name like today's.
findings.independence: The 2026-09-28 424B5 confirms the $13.00 price and the 1,320,000 shares, and limits lock-ups to directors and officers: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1907223/000121390026104114/ea0306753-424b5_green.htm

outside_window.finding: The AnorTech consideration (~US$5.3M of GRML shares priced at the 10-day VWAP at closing, so more shares the lower the price, about 4-5% dilution) is locked up for 12 and 24 months and closes only after TSXV acceptance, which is undated.
The 30-day no-financing covenant and the D&O lock-up from the 2026-09-28 SPA lapse around 2026-10-29, when an issuer that raised five times in five weeks can return to market.
Next earnings is a Zacks cadence estimate only, not a company date.

baseline_tension: The findings net slightly positive, which disagrees with the 42.8% ATR (the strongest free ranker points to continuation), the -46% five-day slide and this name's recent pattern of falls following falls; the low 1.01x volume and the small -5% fall band point mildly the other way.
